== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (<code>1220_68</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 67), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-67-Slip_Sliding_Away.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-slipslidingaway-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), "official text as of April 27, 2013" ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]). Icons as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Cancel Path Of Least Resistance. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your move phase, target opponent's character at an interior Cloud City site. Draw destiny. Relocate target to Weather Vane if destiny > target's ability. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane (if 'hit,' character is first restored to normal).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_68</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, slip number 67 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-67-Slip_Sliding_Away-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B05 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
